system.description:
• Effect: Bonus to saving throws, shown in the Monk Progression Table.
  • Iron Body applies from 1st level against disease, poison, paralysis, polymorph, petrification, and death attacks.
  • Iron Mind applies from 9th level against confusion, charm, fear, and mind-affecting spells.

rules.when: vs disease, poison, paralysis, polymorph, petrification and death attacks (Iron Body)
vs confusion, charm, fear and mind-affecting spells (Iron Mind)
